item.title: UV is great!
item.description:
UV is a python package manager and project manager. It very fast, almost 98% faster than pip-sync Link to heading

I discovered UV after seeing multiple people use it and from Python Discord projects.

item.title: Cursor Composer
item.description:
About Cursor Composer Link to heading

Cursor Composer is an advanced AI-powered coding assistant that helps developers write, edit, and understand code more efficiently. It represents a significant evolution in AI-assisted development tools.

Key Features Link to heading

  • Multi-file editing: Composer can make coordinated changes across multiple files in your codebase, understanding the relationships between different parts of your project.
  • Speed: It is one of the fastest and most accurate models ever.

Benefits Link to heading

Cursor Composer speeds up development by reducing context switching and automating repetitive tasks. It lets developers focus on high-level architecture and problem-solving while the AI handles implementation details. The tool excels at rapidly prototyping ideas, maintaining consistency across large codebases, and helping teams onboard to new projects.

item.title: PSF Refusing 1.5M from US Government
item.description:
In January 2025, the PSF (Python Software Foundation) submitted a proposal to the US government National Science Foundation under the Safety, Security, and Privacy of Open Source Ecosystems program to address structural vulnerabilities in Python and PyPI.

After a few months the PSF got a response from The NSF (National Science Foundation) for a $1.5M grant. The terms of this grant said “do not, and will not during the term of this financial assistance award, operate any programs that advance or promote DEI, or discriminatory equity ideology in violation of Federal anti-discrimination laws.” which means that PSF cannot promote equality during the period in which the NSF gives them the 1.5M. The Python Software Foundation rejected this because equality is a core value of the Python Software Foundation.

item.title: Sora 2
item.description:
Sora was first released in December 9, 2024, it was a good video generation model. It had lots or room to improve. After almost a year, we now have Sora 2. A state of the art video generation model that is really good, especially at realism.

Sora App Link to heading

Sora is available to use in an iOS only app, and is invite only. Though it isn’t that hard to get an invite. The app features a clean, intuitive interface that makes it easy to create videos with just a few taps. Users can input text prompts, adjust settings like duration and aspect ratio, and watch as Sora generates high-quality videos in minutes.

item.title: Making a Homelab
item.description:
Making a Home Lab! Link to heading

Hello everyone in todays blog I will show you how I made my own Home Lab.

The main reason for making a home lab for me, was to have my own RSS reader that I could self host.

First I went to awesome-selfhosted for some inspiration, after a a few hours I decided on Glance, an open source and self hosting dashboard that puts all my feeds in one place. I went through the Installation Guide. I chose to use Docker as it the most simple and straightforward to setup for my needs, as I won’t be changing the source.
